sentences.text: Anushka Sharma -LRB- -LSB- əˈnʊʂkaː ˈʃərmaː -RSB- ; born 1 May 1988 -RRB- is an Indian film actress , producer and model .
She has established a career in Hindi films , and is one of the most popular and highest-paid actresses in India .	Hindi films	Bollywood
She is the recipient of numerous accolades , including one Filmfare Award from seven nominations .	Filmfare Award	Filmfare Award

Born in Ayodhya and raised in Bangalore , Sharma had her first modelling assignment for the fashion designer Wendell Rodricks in 2007 and later moved to Mumbai to pursue a full-time career as a model .	Ayodhya	Ayodhya	Bangalore	Bangalore	Wendell Rodricks	Wendell Rodricks	Mumbai	Mumbai

Following a successful audition at Yash Raj Films , she made her screen debut opposite Shah Rukh Khan in the blockbuster romance Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , which earned a Filmfare Award for Best Actress nomination .	Filmfare Award	Filmfare Award	Yash Raj Films	Yash Raj Films	Shah Rukh Khan	Shah Rukh Khan	Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi	Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi	Filmfare Award for Best Actress	Filmfare Award for Best Actress

Sharma rose to prominence with starring roles in Yash Raj Films 's romances Band Baaja Baaraat -LRB- 2010 -RRB- and Jab Tak Hai Jaan -LRB- 2012 -RRB- ; the latter won her a Best Supporting Actress award at Filmfare .	Yash Raj Films	Yash Raj Films	Band Baaja Baaraat	Band Baaja Baaraat	Jab Tak Hai Jaan	Jab Tak Hai Jaan	Best Supporting Actress	Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress

She had her biggest commercial successes with the roles of a television reporter in the religious satire PK -LRB- 2014 -RRB- and a wrestler in the sports drama Sultan -LRB- 2016 -RRB- , both of which rank among the highest-grossing Indian films .	PK	PK (film)	Sultan	Sultan (2016 film)	highest-grossing Indian films	List of highest-grossing Indian films

Sharma received critical praise for her performances in the 2015 crime thriller NH10 , which also marked her production debut , and the 2016 romantic drama Ae Dil Hai Mushkil , both of which earned her several awards and nominations .	NH10	NH10	Ae Dil Hai Mushkil	Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
In addition to acting in films , Sharma is the ambassador for multiple brands and products , and has an active social media presence .
She also supports various charities and causes , including gender equality and animal rights .	gender equality	gender equality	animal rights	animal rights
She and her brother , Karnesh Sharma are the founders of the production company Clean Slate Films .	Karnesh Sharma	Karnesh Sharma	Clean Slate Films	Clean Slate Films
